system.description: You magnetically pick up a heavy metallic object within short range and hurl it at a target within short range. With a successful Intellect attack, you deal 10 damage to the target and the object. Effort: Affect an additional target that is adjacent to the first target. Action. Diamagnetism supersedes Magnetize, so if you have both, you can exchange Magnetize for another equal or lower-tier ability from this focus.
